summary: Play Cut the Rope 2 for new great adventures with Om Nom and his friends!
description:
ONE OM NOM. SEVEN SIDEKICKS. COUNTLESS PUZZLES

In his unexpected adventure, Om Nom breaks out of his box and travels through lush forests, busy cities, junkyards and underground tunnels, all in pursuit of one goal – CANDY! 
Along the way, he encounters the Nommies, the cutest candy collecting helpers a little green monster could wish for! 

WHAT'S INSIDE:

• 196 physics-based puzzle levels of candy collecting, rope cutting action
• Super satisfying physics-based gameplay
• Fast-paced, addictive single-player brain teasers
• Hilarious cartoons about Om Nom “Om Nom Stories”
• Play offline anywhere, anytime
• Fun for all ages, from kids to the young at heart

MEET OM NOM’S NEW FRIENDS, THE NOMMIES!

• Roto can carry Om Nom to the best candy catching locations
• Lick can make small bridges with his tongue to help Om Nom reach his goal
• Blue can lift Om Nom to new levels of candy hunting fun
• Toss can throw objects, including candy
• Boo can scare Om Nom to jump to new heights
• Snailbrow bravely rolls on walls and ceilings and pushes candies around, like a boss
• Ginger can burn away obstacles between Om Nom and the candy

THREE WAYS TO PLAY EVERY PUZZLE:

One puzzle means three chances to shine!
Each level comes with fun twists on the same setup:

• Solve the puzzle and feed Om Nom
• Collect the fruit while pulling off the same trick
• Beat the clock to snag two stars in time

Clear all three to earn every medal and show that you can solve tasks fast, smart, and of course sweet!

HOW TO PLAY:

• Cut ropes to deliver candy to Om Nom
• Let Nommies' special abilities help you solve the puzzles
• Use power-ups to tackle tricky levels
• Collect stars and gain coins to get power-ups, new hats and sweets for Om Nom and new finger traces for yourself!

So what are you waiting for? Join Om Nom's adventure, help a cute little monster out, and boost your brainpower with fun, clever, physics-based puzzle challenges now! 

Cut the Rope 2 is free to download and play, however, some in-game items can be purchased for real money. For more information, please see our Terms of Use (https://www.zeptolab.com/terms ) and Privacy Policy (https://www.zeptolab.com/privacy )
